title: There, But Not Here
subtitle: On grief, photographs, and memories that aren't really yours.
label: From the essay
alt_text: Public domain artwork (an early color photograph of two pink roses) shown as a bordered print on lavender, with the title There, But Not Here and subtitle below. Not Plain.

captions.instagram:
There, But Not Here.

Pictures of my mother exist, but they're scattered across Houston, kept by different family members, tucked away in closets where they'll stay. Not thrown away. Just never looked at.

From Not Plain. Read it at the link in bio.

#memoir #grief #familyphotos #narrativenonfiction
